g.text: Two primary roles shaping competency growth, evidence, and career mobility
Early-career engineer building practical technical skills

text.tspan: - Focuses on building technical skills early in his career
- Wants a clear career path and growth path
- Values continuous feedback and real-project recognition
- Wants visibility into future-role and promotion requirements
- Proactively seeks learning and practical guidance

Selected scope: Employee profile export and publishing are part of the main product flow.

text.tspan: - Select a target role and level.
Outcome: One career family has a sufficiently complete matrix and published
- HR Draft: set up roles, levels, matrices, career paths and publish metrics.
- System stores the shared standard and enforces least-privilege access.
- OPEN: HR Admin persona is not defined.
- OPEN: Source and process for the initial current profile are not defined.
Outcome: Employee has a target, gap analysis, first roadmap and persisted actions;
- View current profile; select role/level target; generate and understand priority gaps.
- Employee and Manager agree roadmap and next actions.
- Retain actions, statuses and jointly confirmed history for later follow-up.
- Employee executes actions; Manager views team skills and gaps.
- HR Draft tracks basic gaps/progress; Manager maps learning manually.
Outcome: Previous actions are jointly revisited; verified project evidence updates
- Employee and Manager revisit prior actions, confirm statuses and agree next actions.
- System retains old actions for comparison and persists the confirmed follow-up.
- Employee records evidence/rationale and submits a review request.
- Manager reviews evidence in roadmap context; authorized reviewer verifies it.
- Immutable history; update competencies, gaps, readiness and roadmap.
- Employee and Manager view updated status and continue the cycle.
Outcome: Updated competency data is reused for career opportunities and staffing
- Employee exports, publishes or shares a profile for interviews/client pitches.
- Profile presents personal information, work history and experience.
- Manager uses Employee List, current skills and gap analysis for staffing.
- OPEN: Project skill requirements and systematic project fit are undefined.
- OPEN: Public fields, privacy, access, expiry and revocation are undecided.
